Scenario: Book when a doctor has an available slot
ExpectedResult: Booking succeeds and one slot is reserved

Scenario: Book when no slot is available
ExpectedResult: Booking fails and the slot count is unchanged

Scenario: Request an appointment in the past
ExpectedResult: Request is rejected with a clear reason

Scenario: Create a request with a missing patient ID
ExpectedResult: Invalid patient data is rejected

Scenario: Book for a patient with a preferred name
ExpectedResult: Patient-facing message uses the preferred name

Scenario: Attempt a booking that fails
ExpectedResult: Failure does not change the available-slot count

Scenario: Submit the same booking request twice
ExpectedResult: Only one booking is created and the response is safe to retry

Scenario: Send two concurrent requests for the final slot
ExpectedResult: At most one booking succeeds and no unhandled error occurs

Scenario: Cancel an owned active appointment
ExpectedResult: Appointment is cancelled and exactly one slot is released

Scenario: Repeat cancellation of the same appointment
ExpectedResult: Second cancellation fails safely and does not release another slot

Scenario: User B attempts to cancel User A's appointment
ExpectedResult: Access is denied and the appointment remains active

Scenario: Create a booking and query the database
ExpectedResult: One correct booking record is stored

Scenario: Restart the service after saving a booking
ExpectedResult: The booking is available after restart

Scenario: Force the booking write to fail
ExpectedResult: Partial data is rolled back and the slot remains available

Scenario: Send a reminder for a confirmed appointment
ExpectedResult: One reminder is sent to the intended test recipient

Scenario: Make the SMS provider return an error
ExpectedResult: Booking remains confirmed and the reminder failure is recorded

Scenario: Complete an end-to-end booking
ExpectedResult: Confirmation is shown and persisted state is correct

Scenario: Complete an end-to-end cancellation
ExpectedResult: Cancellation is shown and persisted state is correct

Scenario: Trigger a booking failure
ExpectedResult: Message explains the problem and an appropriate next action

Scenario: Create and cancel a booking
ExpectedResult: Audit entries contain actor action and time without unnecessary patient data
